# Round-bottomed groove fixtures

Original synthetic Apache-2.0 fixtures for quiddity#307 (item 5). No customer geometry is used.
`round_groove_*.step.gz` are generated by `tools/make_round_groove_fixtures.py`
(build123d; the command is in the script's docstring). Each groove is a single torus cut:

- `round_groove_gland_shaft`: an R29 shaft with an O-ring gland, torus R28.5 r1.3 (`shaft`).
- `round_groove_ball_race`: a bearing race, tube r13.6..15.0 minus torus R13.0 r1.3 (`bore`),
  the shape of the race in the #307 report.
- `round_groove_face_glands`: a plate with two face O-ring glands, torus R8.2 r0.7 and
  R6.724 r0.7 centred on the face plane (`face`).
- `round_groove_controls`: a filleted shoulder and a convex bead; torus faces, no groove.

The test is `tests/internal/round_grooves.rs`.
